entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Looks to me like that could be a foothold.[n]Let's see if there's a way to climb up!
entries.uk: Схоже, там можна поставити ногу.[n]Пошукаймо, як туди залізти!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Was that Yoshizawa? She has to be close!
entries.uk: Це була Йошізава? Вона мусить[n]бути поруч!

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Oh no! Let's get to Yoshizawa, quick!

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: Senpai! Let's get out of here!

entries.speaker: [sumi 10 0]
entries.en: This place... It's the same as last year,[n]isn't it?
entries.uk: Це місце... Воно таке саме, як[n]торік, правда?
